_readme: Student side projects — things you built outside coursework. Course work belongs in the repository index instead. Add yourself with a pull request: one entry, own repo, public. Add an optional "url" if the project runs somewhere — the card then opens the live site instead of the repo. Valid colors: navy, sea, teal, moss, amber, sun, rust, plum. Stars, language and the owner avatar are read live from GitHub, so do not put them here.
